headline: Is something blocking me from meeting my soulmate?
note:
FRAME: soulmate x keyword. NO PARTICULAR MAN EXISTS — the read must not fall through to decode-him.

🔴 The ad already tells her she is the problem, which is the best fit on the funnel for this method: the card acquits her, and the block is what is left.

⚠ SHE is the subject of beats 3-6. The return-mhf figures are all male, so he is DESCRIBED in beats 1-2 and retired there — never given intent or motion toward her, or a soulmate lander turns into reunion copy.

⚠ NO FAMILY-LINE LANGUAGE anywhere in the read.

⚠ The ad ASSERTS a block, so pre-flight step 3 fires: all three cards have to open on the same 'yes'. The three affirmations are different shapes — 'you're not lacking' · 'nothing in you is wrong' · 'you didn't need fixing first'.

a: You turned the Magician. You couldn't see a thing, and your hand found the busiest card here.
Look at his hands. One points up, one points down, and both are working.
You asked if something is blocking you from meeting your soulmate. What catches me is that neither of those hands is idle.
And yet nobody has come. And you came in already suspecting something.
Something turns up at the point where this would start. I don't think it began with you.
Let me look closer at what's doing that…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. The backs told you nothing, and you took the one held at one ankle.
Look at the rope. It's a single line, and it does all the holding.
You asked if something is blocking you from meeting your soulmate. One thin line does all the work here, and I can't get past it.
Still, nobody has come. And that's the question you brought me.
The hold is light, and it doesn't slip. I don't think this began with you.
Let me look closer at what's holding it…
c: You turned the Fool. Nothing showed through the backs, and you took the one travelling light.
Look at the bundle on his stick. All he has is in it.
You asked if something is blocking you from meeting your soulmate. A start with almost nothing carried — that's what I keep looking at.
But nobody has come. And you're the one who came asking what's in the way.
Whatever this is, it sits right where things begin. I don't think it started with you.
Let me look closer at what's sitting right there…
